My Evidence Lab completes tip ratings, historical personal-best and efficiency views, fatigue/pause safeguards, safe evidence-use goals and achievements, coach inbox, screenshot/video/voice evidence intake, smart tags, saved views, and notification controls. completed.C014: Persistent coaching experiment comparison implemented. Eligible coaching saves a baseline metric, follows the strongest current recommendation while the baseline is active, automatically links a later same-platform session, and reports Improved/Worsened/Unchanged/Insufficient Evidence with sample sizes, confidence and uncertainty across Web and Android. Random credit outcomes are excluded from success scoring.

admin100.ownerUi: Owner Command Center -> Admin 100 implementation ledger
admin100.rule: A capability is not marked implemented unless a current route, persisted datastore, UI, safety control, and relevant verification concretely back the claim. Remaining provider-dependent C008 capabilities stay visibly provider-configuration-required until real end-to-end provider-backed behavior exists.

monetization25.ownerUi: Owner Command Center -> C008 Provider-independent launch slice
monetization25.privacy: Outbound click measurement is aggregate. The C008 asset ledger does not store raw IP addresses, browser fingerprints, or cross-site visitor identifiers.
monetization25.safety: Commercial resources stay visibly separate from gameplay evidence. HTTPS-only destinations, secret-field rejection, sponsored disclosure, and unsafe guaranteed-profit/winnings claim rejection are enforced server-side.

returnUser49.rule: Return-user analytics describe authorized recorded history only. Personal bests, efficiency summaries, time patterns, ratings, goals and achievements must not be framed as predictions of random outcomes, causal proof, or profit guarantees.

patterns: pace increased while recorded results weakened
long session with no recorded break
coreLoopIntegration.rule: Analysis and C014 comparisons describe authorized recorded evidence only. Correlation is not causation. Random credit outcomes are never treated as proof coaching worked, and no hidden server state or future random outcome is predicted.

exactTelemetryBoundary.rule: Only the separately owned F.S.A. integration may submit exact telemetry.
